scaleme.midnightconfig.title: ScaleMe - Visual Scaling
scaleme.midnightconfig.ownPlayerDescript: Adjust the visual size of your own player model
scaleme.midnightconfig.ownPlayerScale.to: Controls how large or small your own player appears visually
scaleme.midnightconfig.playersDescriptio: Adjust the visual size of other players
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableOtherPlayer: Allow scaling of other players' models (visual only)
scaleme.midnightconfig.otherPlayersScale: Controls how large or small other players appear visually
scaleme.midnightconfig.npcDescription.la: Adjust the visual size of NPC players
Allow scaling of Hypixel NPC player models (visual only)
scaleme.midnightconfig.npcPlayerScale.to: Controls how large or small Hypixel NPC players appear visually
scaleme.midnightconfig.villagerNpcDescri: Adjust the visual size of Villager NPC Scaling
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableVillagerNpc: Allow scaling of Hypixel Villager NPC models (visual only)
Controls how large or small Hypixel Villager NPCs appear visually
scaleme.midnightconfig.smoothedScalingDe: Make changes between scale levels appear smooth
scaleme.midnightconfig.smoothScaling.too: Gradually transition between scale changes for your own player
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemScalingDescri: Adjust the visual size of items and their held positions and animation
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableItemScaleAn: Enable scaling and position adjustments for held items (does not affect animation speed).
scaleme.midnightconfig.onlyAffectWeapons: Only scale weapons and tools, not all items. (Some weapons on Hypixel skyblock may not scale properly, as hypixel don't use a normal weapon or tool item for them.)
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemScale.label: Item Scale
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemScale.tooltip: Controls how large or small held items appear visually
scaleme.midnightconfig.heldItemPositionD: Adjust the position of your held item
scaleme.midnightconfig.heldItemXPosition: Adjust the X position of your held item. Higher values will move the item further to the right.
scaleme.midnightconfig.heldItemYPosition: Adjust the Y position of your held item. Higher values will move the item further up.
scaleme.midnightconfig.heldItemZPosition: Adjust the Z position of your held item. Higher values will move the item closer to you.
scaleme.midnightconfig.heldItemRotationD: Adjust the Rotation of held item
scaleme.midnightconfig.heldItemYawRotati: Adjust the yaw rotation of your held item. Higher values will rotate the item to the right.
scaleme.midnightconfig.heldItemPitchRota: Adjust the pitch rotation of your held item. Higher values will rotate the item towards you.
scaleme.midnightconfig.heldItemRollRotat: Adjust the roll rotation of your held item. Higher values will roll the item to the left.
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableItemSwingMo: Enable modifications to the swing/animation of held items.
scaleme.midnightconfig.ignoreMiningEffec: If enabled, ignores the mining effects increase to animation speed.
scaleme.midnightconfig.disableSwingAnima: If enabled, disables the bobbing effect during item swing animations. Only works if the option 'Item Swing Modifications' or 'Item Scale & Position' is enabled.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemAnimationSpee: Controls the animation speed of held items, 1.0 is normal speed / disabled.
scaleme.midnightconfig.disableItemAnimat: If enabled, completely freezes the item swing animation.
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableCrosshairIn: Display the crosshair when viewing from behind your character (F5 once)
Display the crosshair when viewing from in front of your character (F5 twice)
Prevent cycling to front-facing third person view when pressing F5
